download_single_file: download a single file from a HuggingFace Hub model repo
download_entire_repo: download an entire HuggingFace Hub repo including all files
download_with_filters: download files from a HuggingFace Hub repo filtered by glob patterns
download_private_model: download a private model from HuggingFace Hub using an authentication token
dry_run_download: perform a dry run to preview files that would be downloaded from HuggingFace Hub
